Interface OrderRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<Order,UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Order,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<Order,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<Order,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<Order,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<Order>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Order,UUID>
@Repository public interface OrderRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Order,UUID>
Repository interface for accessing Order entities from the database. Provides methods for retrieving orders by account ID or client ID with pagination and sorting.

    • findByClientId

      @Query("SELECT o FROM Order o, Account a WHERE o.accountId = a.accountId AND a.clientId = :clientId ORDER BY COALESCE(o.filledAt, o.rejectedAt, o.cancelledAt, o.expiredAt, o.submittedAt) DESC, o.orderId DESC") org.springframework.data.domain.Page<Order> findByClientId(@Param("clientId") UUID clientId, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Retrieves a paginated list of orders for the specified client ID across all accounts, most recently completed first (see Order.getCompletedAt()), then by order ID: a limit order placed yesterday that filled today is listed with today's trades.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the client ID
      pageable - the pagination information
      Returns:
      a page of orders for the client

    • findByClientIdCompletedBetween

      @Query("SELECT o FROM Order o, Account a WHERE o.accountId = a.accountId AND a.clientId = :clientId AND COALESCE(o.filledAt, o.rejectedAt, o.cancelledAt, o.expiredAt, o.submittedAt) >= :from AND COALESCE(o.filledAt, o.rejectedAt, o.cancelledAt, o.expiredAt, o.submittedAt) < :to ORDER BY COALESCE(o.filledAt, o.rejectedAt, o.cancelledAt, o.expiredAt, o.submittedAt) DESC, o.orderId DESC") org.springframework.data.domain.Page<Order> findByClientIdCompletedBetween(@Param("clientId") UUID clientId, @Param("from") OffsetDateTime from, @Param("to") OffsetDateTime to, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Retrieves a paginated list of orders for the specified client ID completed within a date range (see Order.getCompletedAt()), most recently completed first, then by order ID.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the client ID
      from - the start of the date range (inclusive)
      to - the end of the date range (exclusive)
      pageable - the pagination information
      Returns:
      a page of orders for the client in the date range

    • findWithoutPositionMovementByStatus

      @Query("SELECT o FROM Order o JOIN FETCH o.instrument WHERE o.status = :status AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT m FROM PositionMovement m WHERE m.orderId = o.orderId) ORDER BY o.filledAt, o.orderId") List<Order> findWithoutPositionMovementByStatus(@Param("status") Order.Status status)
      Finds orders in the given status with no position movement, oldest fill first. For FILLED these are the fills not fully booked yet: the seed data's orders, which start with no execution, and any whose booking stopped after the execution was written. A fill's position movement is its last step (see FillRecorder), and live submission only marks an order FILLED after writing it, so live orders never show up here.
      Parameters:
      status - the order status to look for
      Returns:
      the matching orders, by fill time then id

    • findAcceptedWithFilledExecution

      @Query("SELECT o FROM Order o JOIN FETCH o.instrument WHERE o.status = com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.order.Order.Status.ACCEPTED AND o.acceptedAt < :acceptedBefore AND EXISTS (SELECT e FROM Execution e WHERE e.order = o AND e.status = com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.execution.Execution.Status.FILLED) ORDER BY o.acceptedAt, o.orderId") List<Order> findAcceptedWithFilledExecution(@Param("acceptedBefore") OffsetDateTime acceptedBefore)
      Finds live fills whose booking stopped part-way: orders still ACCEPTED although their FILLED execution is committed, because settling them with account-app failed with an unknown outcome, or the app stopped before recording that it succeeded. Only orders accepted before the cutoff are returned, so a submission still in flight is left alone.
      Parameters:
      acceptedBefore - only orders accepted before this are returned
      Returns:
      the stuck orders, oldest first

    • sumReservedCash

      @Query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.reservedCash), 0) FROM Order o WHERE o.accountId = :accountId AND o.status = com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.order.Order.Status.OPEN AND o.side = com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.order.Order.Side.BUY AND o.orderId <> :excludedOrderId") BigDecimal sumReservedCash(@Param("accountId") UUID accountId, @Param("excludedOrderId") UUID excludedOrderId)
      Sums the cash an account's OPEN buy orders hold back from its buying power.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the account
      excludedOrderId - an order to leave out, e.g. the one now being filled
      Returns:
      the cash held, zero when there is none

    • sumOpenSellQuantity

      @Query(value="SELECT COALESCE(SUM(g.quantity), 0) FROM (SELECT MAX(o.quantity) AS quantity FROM trading.orders o WHERE o.account_id = :accountId AND o.instrument_id = :instrumentId AND o.status = 'OPEN' AND o.side = 'SELL' AND o.order_id <> :excludedOrderId AND (o.oco_group_id IS NULL OR o.oco_group_id NOT IN (SELECT x.oco_group_id FROM trading.orders x WHERE x.order_id = :excludedOrderId AND x.oco_group_id IS NOT NULL)) GROUP BY COALESCE(o.oco_group_id, o.order_id)) g", nativeQuery=true) Long sumOpenSellQuantity(@Param("accountId") UUID accountId, @Param("instrumentId") UUID instrumentId, @Param("excludedOrderId") UUID excludedOrderId)
      Sums the shares of one instrument an account's OPEN sell orders have already promised. The two exits of a bracket sell the same shares, so a group of linked orders counts once, as its largest leg, instead of once per leg.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the account
      instrumentId - the instrument
      excludedOrderId - an order to leave out, e.g. the one now being filled; so is the rest of its group of linked orders, whose shares it is the one to sell
      Returns:
      the shares held, zero when there are none

    • findOcoGroupId

      @Query("SELECT o.ocoGroupId FROM Order o WHERE o.orderId = :orderId") UUID findOcoGroupId(@Param("orderId") UUID orderId)
      Finds the group a linked order belongs to, without loading the order itself.
      Parameters:
      orderId - the order
      Returns:
      the group ID, or null if the order is not linked to others (or does not exist)

    • findGroupForUpdate

      @Lock(PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) @Query("SELECT o FROM Order o WHERE o.ocoGroupId = :ocoGroupId ORDER BY o.orderId") List<Order> findGroupForUpdate(@Param("ocoGroupId") UUID ocoGroupId)
      Loads every order of a one-cancels-other group with row locks taken in ascending ID order. Anything that needs more than one leg locks them through here, so two of them never wait on each other's rows in opposite orders.
      Parameters:
      ocoGroupId - the group
      Returns:
      the group's orders, lowest ID first

    • lockAccount

      @Query(value="SELECT account_id FROM trading.accounts WHERE account_id = :accountId FOR UPDATE", nativeQuery=true) List<Object> lockAccount(@Param("accountId") UUID accountId)
      Locks the account's row for the rest of the transaction, so two orders on one account can't both count the same cash or shares as free.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the account to lock
      Returns:
      the account ID if the account exists
